_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED BY THE 8/27 OPEN, WHICH IS THE RUN THE 8/26 PRE-CLOSE EXPLICITLY ASSIGNED THIS REMOVAL TO. THE NVDA ROW IS DELETED BECAUSE ITS EVENT HAS PASSED AND IS NOW A FACT RATHER THAN A FORECAST: a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-27 returns NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, with an ACTUAL of 2.22 against the 2.09 estimate the row carried, a 6.2% beat. The row's job was to hold a dated binary ahead of the board and it no longer holds one. ITS REASONING IS NOT LOST WITH IT, AND THAT WAS ARRANGED IN ADVANCE. Branch one was restated on the MRVL row by the 8/26 pre-close for exactly this reason - a catalyst whose only home is inside a row about to be deleted is a catalyst the file loses on the morning it matters - and THAT RESTATEMENT IS WHAT REFUSED THIS MORNING'S BEST CANDIDATE. ANET, a day-2 continuation of its own 8/26 breakout on the tightest spread of roughly sixty names quoted, with no earnings until 2026-11-03 and item 2 passing cleanly at +0.42%, was refused because a five-session hold opened today wears tonight's MRVL gap and a -8% stop cannot be honoured across it. The branch was written on 8/21 and widened on that same date from '8/25 or 8/26' to include 8/27 precisely so that this morning could not fall through the gap. It cost a good candidate, which is the only kind of pre-commitment worth having. THE MRVL ROW STAYS AND ITS SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE RATHER THAN CARRIED: 247.03 bid / 247.27 ask at 13:50:36.855946331Z, last 247.175, against a 245.110 settled close - UP 0.78% on the session and up 1.38% from the 243.67 the row carried yesterday. It reports TONIGHT after the close, re-verified on this pull as MRVL, 2026-08-27, timing pm, verified true, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027, no actual yet. The 8/28 open owns pruning it. impliedMove stays null on it and that is a DISCHARGED check rather than an outstanding one: item 3 is owed before an earnings HOLD, both position lists returned empty on a live pull at 09:44, the only live specification is BOX which is outside the complex and whose own next report is roughly late November, so there is no hold to place a straddle before and a number quoted for a position nobody will take measures nothing. AMD'S MECHANICAL BLOCK IS NOW RECORDED ON THE BOARD RATHER THAN IN THIS FILE, because with the NVDA row gone the note that carried it goes too: AMD is 478.77 bid, -0.45% on the session and the cleanest sympathy laggard in the chain on a day NVDA is +7.33%, and one share is 47.4% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling. It is in state.json candidates with AMAT at 47.6%, MU at 93.3%, TSM at 41.8% and SNPS at 42.7%, all blocked the same way.

moves.source: PROMOTED TO ITS OWN ROW ON 8/26 BY THE PRE-CLOSE RUN, and the 8/27 open is the session that proves the promotion was worth making: the NVDA row it used to live inside was DELETED this morning, and this row's branch one is what refused today's best candidate. Re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-27: MRVL, 2026-08-27, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027 - unchanged from the 8/25 and 8/26 pulls. THE EVENT IS TONIGHT. Spot is a LIVE quote and not carried: 247.03 bid / 247.27 ask at 13:50:36.855946331Z on a 0.10% spread, last trade 247.175, against a 245.110 settled close - UP 0.78% on the session and up 1.38% from the 243.67 this row carried yesterday. Notably MRVL is +0.78% on a session where NVDA is +7.33%, so the read-through the market is pricing into it ahead of its own number is muted rather than euphoric. That is information about positioning and it changes NOTHING about the refusal, which rests on the gap and not on the direction. WHAT THIS ROW DID TODAY, RECORDED BECAUSE A BRANCH THAT NEVER BINDS IS NOT EVIDENCE OF ANYTHING: branch one refused ANET at 09:50, a day-2 continuation of its own 8/26 breakout quoting a 0.103% spread with no earnings until 2026-11-03 and item 2 passing at +0.42% - the best setup on the tape by the run's own ranking. It also refused VRT, COHR, CRDO, ALAB, ARM, INTC, LSCC, KLAC, LRCX, TER, ONTO, MTSI, FORM, AMKR and a re-strike of SMTC. The published entry, BOX, sits outside the complex entirely. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED, and that is discharged rather than outstanding: nothing is open, the only live specification is outside this complex, and item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold. A number that was not pulled does not get written down as though it were. The 8/28 open owns pruning this row once the print is out.

branches.cond: An entry considered in MRVL itself, or in a semiconductor sympathy name, on 8/27 into this print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: This is the NVDA row's branch one applied to the second print rather than a new judgement, and it is written here so that deleting the NVDA row tomorrow does not delete the reasoning with it. The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it - and refused SMTC a hold through tonight on the same item 3 test this morning. Nothing about MRVL's own move is the exposure being priced here; the exposure is that a stop cannot be honoured across a gap, in either direction, and one evening's rally does not change that arithmetic any more than one evening's sell-off does.

branches.cond: NVDA's print tonight moves MRVL hard before its own report tomorrow evening
branches.act: Not traded on that move, in either direction, before 8/28
branches.why: A sympathy gap on someone else's number, with the name's OWN dated binary still ahead of it the following evening, is the worst version of the setup this file exists to refuse: it takes the index gap without the index's liquidity, and then holds a second event on top of it. Cheapness after an NVDA miss is the MRVL binary being priced, not a support level, and strength after an NVDA beat is a continuation spike into a print, which item 2 calls a wait signal. The first point the rulebook can engage this name at all is the 8/28 session, after both numbers are known, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/27
branches.act: The 8/27 pre-close decides it explicitly against this row, and a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first
branches.why: The same test the 8/26 pre-close applied to the NVDA row, restated here for the second print so the duty survives the first row being deleted. A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed and must not be closed early on a date that has nothing to do with it, but two semiconductor prints on consecutive evenings is precisely when correlation shows up in names that showed none for a month. Item 3 binds either way: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH an event belonging to another ticker whose gap it will nonetheless wear.
